svg.title: Splatypus workflow with official tool logos and data formats
svg.desc: Photos and videos pass through FFmpeg, COLMAP and Brush. JPG and COLMAP binary models form the training dataset. Gaussian splat PLY files can be rendered with Rhino Gaussian Splatting or Krill, or viewed as a point cloud. Optional alignment passes through COLMAP TXT and BIN models.

g.text: Splatypus · from media to Gaussian splats
Official tool artwork · file formats shown at each handoff
Images and their matching camera model travel together.
Logos: FFmpeg · COLMAP · Brush · Rhino Gaussian Splatting · Krill / Verkare. Splatypus icons from this project.
